topic: Why the big nuts end up on top when you shake a mix

through_line.name: the red jar lid
through_line.progression: the glass jar's signal-red lid rattles as the jar shakes, stays clamped on while the gaps open inside, rattles again as the big nut climbs, then pops off to show the big nut sitting on top
through_line.resolution: the red lid pops off the jar and the big nut sits right on top of the mix

blocks.vo_line: Shake mixed nuts and the big ones climb. Stay to the end and watch one rise to the top.
blocks.promise: Stay to the end and watch one rise to the top.
blocks.through_line_state: the jar's red lid rattles as the whole jar shakes side to side
shots: CU frontal: a clear glass jar with a signal-red clay lid already shaking side to side on the sandy table, full of small tan clay peanuts with one big brown clay Brazil nut buried near the bottom
ECU macro: the red lid rattling on top of the jar as it shakes
MEDIUM low angle: through the glass, the big brown nut low down among the small tan peanuts, everything jiggling
WIDE high angle: the whole sunny clay table with the shaking jar in the middle and the sky-blue window behind
MEDIUM lateral: the jar gives one last shake and stops, the big nut a little higher than before, then everything settles
blocks.audio: a busy clay rattle of nuts in glass, a tinny clatter from the lid, a soft thud as the jar stops
blocks.direction_note: The jar shakes side to side and stays upright. The big nut only moves UP, never down.

overlays.text:
The *biggest* nuts
rise to the top

blocks.vo_line: Every shake opens tiny gaps under the big nut, and the small ones slip down into them.
blocks.through_line_state: the red lid sits clamped on top of the giant cutaway jar while the gaps open below the big nut
shots: WIDE frontal: a giant cutaway of the jar like a cream clay window box, packed with small tan clay peanuts and one big brown Brazil nut in the middle, the red lid along the top edge
CU lateral: the whole pile jolts upward and a dark gap opens right under the big brown nut
ECU macro: two small tan peanuts tumble down into the dark gap under the big nut and fill it
MEDIUM overhead: cream clay arrows pressed into the cutaway, small arrows pointing DOWN beside the little peanuts and one big arrow pointing UP under the big nut, no letters
CU low angle: the pile settles with the big nut now resting on the small peanuts that filled its gap, then everything settles
blocks.audio: a hollow clay jolt, a soft pitter-patter of small nuts dropping, a gentle settling crunch
blocks.direction_note: Small peanuts only fall DOWN into the gap. The big nut only goes UP. Arrows: small ones point down, the big one points up.

blocks.vo_line: So why doesn't the big nut fall back? Because its old spot, right below, is already full.
blocks.through_line_state: the red lid stays on as the big nut tries to drop and lands on the filled-in spot
shots: MEDIUM frontal: in the cutaway, the big brown nut sinks a little, then stops, sitting on a tight bed of small tan peanuts
ECU macro: the small peanuts packed firmly where the big nut used to be, no gap left
CU lateral: the big brown nut wiggles but cannot push back down into the packed small peanuts
WIDE high angle: the whole cutaway with the big nut clearly higher than at the start and the red lid above
MEDIUM low angle: the big nut rests on its new higher spot, then everything settles
blocks.audio: a dull clay bump as the big nut lands, a tight crunchy creak, a quiet settling tap
blocks.direction_note: The big nut never sinks below where it was; the small peanuts stay packed under it.

blocks.vo_line: With every shake, it climbs one gap at a time, until the biggest nuts sit right on top.
blocks.delivers_promise: the jar shakes and the big brown nut climbs up through the small peanuts gap by gap until it pops out on top of the mix, and the red lid pops off
blocks.comment_question: What always ends up on top in your bag?
blocks.through_line_state: the red lid rattles with each shake and pops off as the big nut reaches the top
shots: CU frontal: through the glass, the big brown nut halfway up the jar, the jar shaking side to side
ECU macro: the big brown nut nudging upward between small tan peanuts with each shake
MEDIUM lateral: the big brown nut breaks out on top of the small peanuts and sits there
CU low angle: the signal-red lid pops off the jar and wobbles on the table
WIDE high angle: the open jar on the sunny table with the big brown nut resting right on top of the mix, then everything settles
blocks.audio: a rhythmic clay rattle, a soft pop as the lid comes off, a light wobble of the lid on the table
blocks.direction_note: The big nut only climbs UP through the jar and ends on top. The jar stays upright.

overlays.text:
What always ends up
on *top* in your bag?

palette_lock: painted sky-blue backdrop with cotton-wool clouds, cream, warm sand, tan clay peanuts, a brown clay Brazil nut, clear glass; signal red ONLY on the jar lid
